name: Overnight trend continues at the cash open
why: A one-directional overnight (Asia + Europe pushing the same way) reflects global institutions repositioning; US real money joins at 09:30 in the same direction.

checks.when: !rollwin && abs(open - pc) >= x*atr && (onh - onl) > 0 && abs(open - pc) >= 0.7*(onh - onl)
